allow: PowerShell(if \(\(Get-ChildItem Development -Force\).Count -eq 0\) { "Development folder is EMPTY" } else { Get-ChildItem Development -Recurse -Force | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName } })
PowerShell(Get-ChildItem ticket-system\\src -Recurse -Depth 2 -Force | Where-Object { -not $_.PSIsContainer } | Measure-Object | Select-Object Count)
PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match "node" } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, @{N='Memory\(MB\)';E={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet64 / 1MB, 1\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize)
